// 마음번역소 오리지널 생성형 BGM
// 외부 음원/샘플을 사용하지 않고 Web Audio API로 실시간 합성합니다.
// 브라우저 자동재생 정책 때문에 첫 사용자 클릭 이후 시작됩니다.
const BGM={
 ctx:null, master:null, musicGain:null, timer:null, step:0, enabled:true, started:false,
 volumeLevels:[0.035,0.065,0.095], volumeIndex:1,
 // Cmaj7 → Am7 → Fmaj7 → Gsus2 : 따뜻하고 긴장감이 적은 반복 진행
 chords:[[48,52,55,59],[45,48,52,55],[41,45,48,52],[43,48,50,55]],
 melody:[64,67,71,67,69,67,64,62,64,67,72,71,69,67,64,62,65,69,72,69,67,65,64,60,62,67,69,67,64,62,60,59],
 midi(n){return 440*Math.pow(2,(n-69)/12)},
 ensure(){
  if(this.ctx) return;
  const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;
  if(!AC) return;
  this.ctx=new AC();
  this.master=this.ctx.createGain();
  this.musicGain=this.ctx.createGain();
  const comp=this.ctx.createDynamicsCompressor();
  comp.threshold.value=-24; comp.knee.value=24; comp.ratio.value=3; comp.attack.value=.02; comp.release.value=.3;
  this.master.gain.value=.92;
  this.musicGain.gain.value=this.volumeLevels[this.volumeIndex];
  this.musicGain.connect(comp); comp.connect(this.master); this.master.connect(this.ctx.destination);
 },
 async start(){
  if(!this.enabled) return;
  this.ensure(); if(!this.ctx) return;
  try{if(this.ctx.state==='suspended') await this.ctx.resume()}catch(e){}
  if(this.started) return;
  this.started=true; this.step=0;
  this.tick();
  this.timer=setInterval(()=>this.tick(),620);
  this.updateUI();
 },
 stop(){
  if(this.timer){clearInterval(this.timer);this.timer=null}
  this.started=false;
  if(this.musicGain&&this.ctx){
   const t=this.ctx.currentTime;
   this.musicGain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(t);
   this.musicGain.gain.setTargetAtTime(0.0001,t,.08);
  }
  this.updateUI();
 },
 async toggle(){
  this.enabled=!this.enabled;
  if(this.enabled){
   if(this.musicGain&&this.ctx)this.musicGain.gain.value=this.volumeLevels[this.volumeIndex];
   await this.start();
  }else this.stop();
  this.updateUI();
 },
 cycleVolume(){
  this.volumeIndex=(this.volumeIndex+1)%this.volumeLevels.length;
  if(this.musicGain&&this.ctx){
   const t=this.ctx.currentTime;
   this.musicGain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(t);
   this.musicGain.gain.setTargetAtTime(this.volumeLevels[this.volumeIndex],t,.08);
  }
  const icons=['🔈','🔉','🔊'];
  const b=document.getElementById('volBtn'); if(b)b.textContent=icons[this.volumeIndex];
 },
 tick(){
  if(!this.ctx||!this.enabled) return;
  const now=this.ctx.currentTime+.03;
  // 8스텝마다 부드러운 패드 화음
  if(this.step%8===0){
   const chord=this.chords[Math.floor(this.step/8)%this.chords.length];
   chord.forEach((m,i)=>this.pad(this.midi(m),now,5.1,i));
  }
  // 짝수 스텝에는 작은 벨/피아노 느낌의 선율
  if(this.step%2===0){
   const note=this.melody[this.step%this.melody.length];
   this.pluck(this.midi(note),now,.55);
   if(this.step%8===4)this.pluck(this.midi(note-12),now+.14,.38);
  }
  // 아주 낮은 베이스는 코드 첫 음만 드문드문
  if(this.step%8===0){
   const root=this.chords[Math.floor(this.step/8)%this.chords.length][0]-12;
   this.bass(this.midi(root),now,2.8);
  }
  this.step=(this.step+1)%32;
 },
 pad(freq,t,dur,voice){
  const o=this.ctx.createOscillator(), g=this.ctx.createGain(), f=this.ctx.createBiquadFilter();
  o.type=voice%2===0?'sine':'triangle'; o.frequency.value=freq; o.detune.value=(voice-1.5)*4;
  f.type='lowpass'; f.frequency.value=1250; f.Q.value=.35;
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.045,t+.65); g.gain.setValueAtTime(.045,t+dur-1.2); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+dur);
  o.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(this.musicGain);o.start(t);o.stop(t+dur+.05);
 },
 pluck(freq,t,dur){
  const o=this.ctx.createOscillator(), g=this.ctx.createGain(), f=this.ctx.createBiquadFilter();
  o.type='trian
